nodes.label: Rikuna MVP Schema Design (RIK-1 v3)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth is specs/RIKUNA-PRD-schema-basedatos-rikuna.md Sections 2-7; this migration file should not be edited for future schema changes — add a new timestamped migration instead. Seasons/episodes are explicitly out of MVP scope (Section 2.3).

nodes.label: RLS Enablement Design (RIK-1)
nodes.rationale: RLS is enabled on ALL 14 tables, not only personal-data ones, because Supabase's default project-level privileges grant the authenticated role table-level INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on public schema tables; restricting RLS to personal-data tables would leave catalog tables writable by any authenticated end user. service_role bypasses RLS automatically (BYPASSRLS), so ingestion routines are unaffected. auth.uid() calls are wrapped in (select auth.uid()) per Supabase's RLS performance guidance (initplan caching instead of a per-row function call) — behaviorally identical to the spec doc's bare auth.uid().

nodes.label: Stub-Only Insert Policy Design (RIK-4)
nodes.rationale: RIK-1's RLS migration (20260809134405) only granted SELECT on the catalog group, leaving no authenticated-role write policy, so a user-triggered IMDb import could not create stub titles/genres/people without a service-role client. This migration is policy-only — no table or column changes. media_items insert is scoped to is_stub = true so an authenticated user can only ever insert a stub row, never a fully-enriched one. genres/people/media_genres/media_people have no owner or stub concept of their own, so their insert is left unrestricted for the authenticated role, matching what the ingestion/catalog service-role path would produce.

nodes.label: Query 8.1: "Qué ver este mes"
nodes.rationale: Watchlist ∩ available-on-active-subscription ∩ not-watched, ordered by imdb_rating desc — the product's core cross-reference; deliberately computed live (not cached) so marking a title watched has immediate effect.

nodes.label: Query 8.2: Discovery recommendations
nodes.rationale: Well-rated (imdb_rating>=7.0), available, unseen titles outside the watchlist, limited to 50 rows, with a minimum vote floor (imdb_votes>=5000) to avoid false 'hidden gems' with too few votes.

nodes.label: Canonical shared media-status write action
nodes.rationale: actions/media-status/index.ts exports markWatched/markNotWatched/addToWatchlist/removeFromWatchlist as the single canonical mutation point so RIK-7 and RIK-8 do not duplicate user_media_status write logic; every write forces source='manual' and manually_edited=true.

nodes.label: isPublicView flag pattern
nodes.rationale: Because /titulo/[slug] is documented as both an authenticated and a public screen but Next.js route groups cannot resolve the same URL twice, the ficha is one physical route with a single shared component gated by an isPublicView boolean derived from an optional session check.

nodes.label: getPublicListUrl stub helper
nodes.rationale: RIK-10 ships lib/lists/getPublicListUrl.ts returning null unconditionally, as a thin interface point so the 'copy link' UI and RIK-11's later public-code implementation compose without both tickets editing the same mechanism.

nodes.label: public_code global sharing mechanism
nodes.rationale: user_lists.slug is unique only per-user, unsafe as a public link identifier once multiuser opens; RIK-11 adds a separate globally-unique public_code column (nullable, assigned once on first publish, stable across future toggles, retried on collision) instead.

nodes.label: proxy.ts Next.js 16 root guard convention
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16 deprecated and renamed the root middleware.ts file convention to proxy.ts (exported function proxy, not middleware); the ticket text and ARCHITECTURE.md still say middleware.ts, which is treated as stale terminology rather than instruction.

nodes.label: RECOMMENDATION_THRESHOLDS constant
nodes.rationale: Extracts the 7.0 rating / 5000 votes literals out of raw SQL into constants/recommendationThresholds.ts (minRating, minImdbVotes, minVotesFloor) per ARCHITECTURE.md's naming, so thresholds are not magic numbers inline in a query.

nodes.label: base-lyra design system style
nodes.rationale: shadcn/ui style 'lyra' with base color 'mist' and zero border-radius everywhere, chosen because Rikuna is a utilitarian data-decision tool, not a social app; the real project migrated the Radix-based 'lyra' onto a Base UI variant named 'base-lyra' in components.json, diverging from this doc's own config snippet.

nodes.label: lib/supabase/admin.ts ingestion-only boundary
nodes.rationale: The service-role Supabase client is reserved exclusively for ingestion/ routines (catalog snapshots, availability upserts) that write to service-role-write-only catalog tables under RLS; every user-facing actions/ or services/ file must instead use the RLS-scoped request client and never import admin.ts.

nodes.label: manually_edited overwrite-protection rule
nodes.rationale: user_media_status.manually_edited=true protects a user's in-app manual edits from being silently overwritten by a later IMDb CSV reimport; every manual write must set source='manual' and manually_edited=true, and reimport logic must check this flag before overwriting watched/want_to_watch fields.
